notes.title: Update 1.1.1 is HERE!
notes.content:
Hello!

It's been nearly 2 months since the release of the Fur & Flames Update, and players have been super happy about it!

And since then, we've learned that Forgotten Mines was nominated at Gamescom Latam for "Best Game Brazil". It's a HUGE honor, so we couldn't be happier!

We're still working on the game, and we can't wait to show you what we have planned for the next Major Update...

In the meantime, today we have a new patch that fixes a lot of issues + 2 improvements!

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] skills with damage now show a "base power" modifier at the end of the descriptive text, in brackets. e.g.: [60].
[*] With the exception of Rasinok, who always offers the raven armor, the other ancient deities now offer a random legendary item when the pact is sealed.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfix[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixed bug that returned nullptr when a player tried to change the name of a character with a new species.
[*] Fixed bug when a square on the battle map become unasable when a character die.
[*] Fixed character unable to act after restart by wipe
[*] Fixed character dying when restarting if he was above water
[*] Fixed crash when earth elemental geo move out of map.
[*] -Fixed some items that did not get bonus from blacksmith.
[/list]

Don't forget to update your game!

notes.title: Fur & Flames Update is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello!

Today's the day! The Fur & Flames Update is FINALLY available, so time to go back to the fight and reclaim your mines!

[h1]Fur & Flames Update[/h1]

Two things I really wish there were more options for in the game were the playable species and the enemy variety. This update basically arises from this desire. 

Shortly after launch last July, I had the idea of the plasmoids. I had been playing with this idea for a while. I thought about doing an update entirely focused on them, a type of “Plasmoid Invasion!”. Plasmoid enemies and a playable plasmoid species would exist in this update. 

After reflecting a little, I came to beasts and elementals, and, honestly, I found these ideas to be more exciting for players. But nevertheless, I still wanted the presence of plasmoids in the update. I thought about expanding the lore of this universe a little, creating dwarves from the far north and a catfolk from the plains below the mountains of Dorvgrad. I also had decided that I would make at least 50 new items. Well, I ended up making 68 new items that will give players more options for different builds and compositions during their runs.

So yeah, the update got [b]quite big[/b], so I hope you'll like it!

Now, time for all the new stuff that this update is bringing to the game!

[h1]New Areas[/h1]

After finishing the game, the player will gain access to a choice of path for his run. The standard path is made up of the areas we already know (Verdant Halls, Muddy Tunnels, Ancient Prison and Gates of Hell). An alternative path can be accessed by the player. From the third area onwards, the player will find the traditional path again, that is, the new path will have a composition with two areas different from the standard path ([b]Beast Path, Elemental Caves[/b], Ancient Prison and Gates of Hell).

Those new areas bring:
[list]
[b][*] 12 new enemies
[*] 8 bosses[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Beasts' Path[/h2]

A forgotten and wild piece of Verdant Halls. Beasts of all sorts took shelter here throughout the centuries of abandonment. Atrocious animals and even magical beasts can be found, without much effort in searching. The place is a jungle inside the mines

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/b9f837bb07e166b4188bbbb3d1c85a54214e2b47.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/526a9a7d720d4e59f8a7ad6d9e07fc7f61ba7ada.png[/img]

[h2]Elemental Caves[/h2]

Rifts to the outermost elemental planes have been heedlessly opened for decades by the Elemental Cults of Dorvgrad. The result is an absurd population of Elementals of all types and powers roaming these caves. They say that in the most desolate parts of the Elemental Caves, some ancient elementals live.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/8203c628e5a11eb560acfd1ca9d71887df6f502d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/835d2609b8f88e60a3a59145f1a384d06116bb5b.png[/img]



[h1]New races[/h1]

Those new races will bring even more replayability to the game!

[list]
[*]Northern Dwarves, who conquered the inhospitable tundras and mountains of the far north of the continent. They have grayish skin with different bluish tones and, in contrast, very red eyes. They are experts in the use of northern weapons and capable of great feats in battle.
[*]Plasmoid: Single-celled creatures from another dimension. It has a central nervous nucleus, its only organ, visible in the center of its head. It is believed that Plasmoids adhere to the humanoid form as soon as they enter the material plane.
[*]Jenguren Folks: Humanoid felines, slightly larger than humans. They occupy the forests and plains at the foot of the Dorvgrad mountains. They mostly worship Jenguren, to whom they attribute their creation and motivation in life.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/331b4fbba94d88ccee162d4b9c97ee75e4469880.png[/img]


[h1]New amulets[/h1]

There are 3 new amulets with this update:
[list]
[*][b]Claw Amulet[/b]: Increases damage dealt to Beats by 25%
[*][b]Core Amulet[/b]: Increases damage dealt to Elementals by 25%
[*][b]Northern Amulet[/b]: Increases damage by 25% when equipped with a Nortern weapon
[/list]


[h1]New equipments[/h1]

There are 68 new equipments (weapons, armors, accessories) in this update! Even more customization, we hope you'll have fun with them!


[h1]Bug fixing[/h1]

With this update we're bringing bug-fixing that you reported to us! Thanks again!!

[list]
[*]Fixed the issue where a tile was unusable if a character died after being attacked by a monster
[*]Fixed the gladiator class that automatically changed weapon after every loading screen
[*]Fixed a bug making the characters unusable when starting over after a wipe
[*]Fixed a bug allowing to absorb the stats of the items by restarting a combat
[*]Fixed the pop-up generated by the item added by the merchant's amulet, so now it correctly disappears after moving the cursor
[/list]

So yeah... this update is BIG, and hopefully players will be happy!

On a final note, more and more people are playing the game, and we couldn't be more proud! So, thanks for all the support you all have given us <3

notes.title: The Fur & Flames Update is coming!
notes.content:
Hello Miners!

We hope you're okay! Wow, Forgotten Mines has been out for nearly 4 months now, time flies fast!

As promised in September 2024, we've been working on new content for Forgotten Mines, and while we're still working on it, we have some news about it!

[h1]The Fur & Flames Update[/h1]

After the release of Forgotten Mines and seeing how many players loved the game (THANK YOU AGAIN), we knew we wanted to keep working on the game to make it even better and bigger. Soo we got a BIT ambitious with this next update, but we hope you'll like it! 

The 1.1 Update for Forgotten Mines will be called "Fur & Flames Update" and will bring new races, new equipments, and new areas! But let us tell you a bit more about it. Please keep in mind that the update is still being worked on, so there are still some things that might be different from what we're announcing here, but the general idea will stay the same. 

[h2]New races[/h2]

3 new races will be available in the 1.1 update, increasing the roaster even more!
[list]
[*][b]Northern Dwarves[/b], who conquered the inhospitable tundras and mountains of the far north of the continent. They have grayish skin with different bluish tones and, in contrast, very red eyes. They are experts in the use of northern weapons and capable of great feats in battle. 
[*][b]Plasmoid[/b]:  Single-celled creatures from another dimension. It has a central nervous nucleus, its only organ, visible in the center of its head. It is believed that Plasmoids adhere to the humanoid form as soon as they enter the material plane. 
[*][b]Jenguren Folks[/b]: Humanoid felines, slightly larger than humans. They occupy the forests and plains at the foot of the Dorvgrad mountains. They mostly worship Jenguren, to whom they attribute their creation and motivation in life. 
[/list]

[h2]New areas[/h2]

We'll add new areas to the game!

[h3]Beasts' Path[/h3]

A forgotten and wild piece of Verdant Halls. Beasts of all sorts took shelter here throughout the centuries of abandonment. Atrocious animals and even magical beasts can be found, without much effort in searching. The place is a jungle inside the mines

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/526a9a7d720d4e59f8a7ad6d9e07fc7f61ba7ada.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/b9f837bb07e166b4188bbbb3d1c85a54214e2b47.png[/img]

[h3]Elemental Caves[/h3]

Rifts to the outermost elemental planes have been heedlessly opened for decades by the Elemental Cults of Dorvgrad. The result is an absurd population of Elementals of all types and powers roaming these caves. They say that in the most desolate parts of the Elemental Caves, some ancient elementals live.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/8203c628e5a11eb560acfd1ca9d71887df6f502d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/835d2609b8f88e60a3a59145f1a384d06116bb5b.png[/img]

After you finish the Elemental Caves, you'll go to the usual third area, which is the Ancient Prison. As you can see in the screenshots, there will be [b]new enemies[/b] in those new areas and [b]new bosses[/b]! 

Also, we're working on bringing 68 new equipments, including weapons, armors and accessories!

As you can see, this is a VERY ambitious update, with a million parameters to take into account for the balancing, new assets to produce, testing...

This means that we're now aiming to release this big update for early 2025. We apologize for the delay, and hope you'll enjoy it!

[*] Fixed a bug that randomly deleted units' armor and accessories after a restart

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello Miners,

today we have a brand new update for Forgotten Mines, bringing some much-needed bug-fixing! We also want to thank you all the players for reporting the issues, that has been very helpful to fix them.

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where .exe could be read as malware, due to an embed .pck file. Now the .pck file is exported separately alongside the .exe.
[*]After finding [spoiler]Rayk[/spoiler] once, the player will always have information on his location.
[*]Corrected soft-lock with passive healing. 
[*]Fixed corrupted save in descent mode after heroes reach lvl6
[*]Fixed a bug where, when restarting the game in animal form (wolf or bear), the Druid would lose maximum HP.
[*]It is no longer possible to buy a poe stone after refreshing the items.
[*]Fixed the price of the poe stone 
[*]The player can now change the name of their units on the new game screen.
[*]Fixed a bug where, when the inventory was full and battle was restarted, an "error" sound was emitted.
[/list]

We also want to thank you all for the very positive reviews, and we've now reached the 100 reviews threshold! 

If you still have bugs/issues about your game, please give us as much info as possible so we can investigate on them as best as we can! :) Our immediate objective is the stability of the game and get rid of the remaining issues.

Thank you for your patience!

If you want to chat with me and discuss strategies with other players, you can join the [url=discord.gg/pFreZSEgxQ][b]Discord[/b][/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/forgotten_mines][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Good day Heroes!

Today, we have a brand new patch for Forgotten Mines, bringing some much-neede bug fixing!
[list]
[*]Hero can no longer be revived because of perks with passive regeneration causing softlock. 
[*]If you change equipped item while one of your character is on an item on the ground, the unequipped item will no longer be lost. 
[*]Fixed hero keeping bonus HP from leveling up after restarting battle. 
[*]Fixed some text going out of bounds in some languages. 
[*]Some adjustments have been made to the reroll button. The button should no longer disappear after too many rerolls. Persk should no longer reroll in the same two perks. If there is only two possible perks, the button will no longer be displayed. 
[*]Controller: Fixed a bug that duplicated items when equipping them. 
[*]Controller : A feedback has been added to the "diamond to gold button" in the guild screen to show the player the button is selected.
[*]Fixed Vsync to no longer be turned on after restarting the game.
[/list]

We're still working on fixing other reported bugs, one of the most urgent ones is the issue where players sometimes lose their equipments after restarting the battle. 

If you still have bugs/issues about your game, please give us as much info as possible so we can investigate on them as best as we can! :) 

Thank you for your patience!

If you want to chat with me and discuss strategies with other players, you can join the [url=discord.gg/pFreZSEgxQ][b]Discord[/b][/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/forgotten_mines][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!

notes.title: Forgotten Mines is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Greetings Heroes!

I hope you're settled on a strategy, the classes you'd like to try and the skills you'll pick leveling up because I'm beyond thrilled to announce that...

[h1]Forgotten Mines is officially OUT![/h1]

[previewyoutube=F2E375Pe_rM;full][/previewyoutube]
Play a squad of Heroes trying to get their mines back from dangerous foes. [b]Build your team[/b] and pick from a [b]wide variety of classes[/b]: Healers, Archers, Fighters, Mages and more. Each new room will test your skills with [b]intense fights[/b] and [b]limited turns[/b], and believe me, you don't want to know what happens [strike]when[/strike] if you fail. Only few have returned... Anyway, while navigating through those treacherous mines, collect [b]awesome equipment[/b], upgrade it, sell and buy new one [b]to fit your team and your strategy[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2238630/Forgotten_Mines/

Working on Forgotten Mines has been a hell of a ride. I can't wait for you to play the game and, again, if you have any thought to share, please do. I'll be happy to read you!

If you want to chat with me and discuss strategies with other players, you can join the [url=discord.gg/pFreZSEgxQ][b]Discord[/b][/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/forgotten_mines][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!

notes.content:
Good day Heroes!

Can you believe It's already [b]D-4 before Forgotten Mines' release?![/b]
So, to show you how far the game has come since the First Demo back in 2022, here's a blogpost to explain and show you the major changes!

[h2]First Demo[/h2]

For starters, I had never published a game on Steam before, but I did some research and knew it needed a good vertical slice. I developed a substantial demo that showcased the game up to its midpoint (but with a lot less content, of course), and despite my initial uncertainties, many of my decisions proved effective and contributed to my current progress. Essentially, my aim was to demonstrate that [b]the game offered lots of content despite its minimalist appearance.[/b]

The core mechanics of Forgotten Mines have remained largely unchanged from the project's inception. While numerous enhancements have been added since then, the fundamental gameplay elements were established early on. [b]Essentially I aimed to highlight the demo's extensive content, the distinctiveness of each character class and show that the classes were different from each other.[/b] I recall releasing the demo only after creating the Druid, which was the most distinctive class available at the time.

[h2]Now[/h2]

Concerning the most significant changes; the UI was the standout. Until December last year, it hindered both players and the game itself. Substantial overhauls were made to the entire UI, marking it as the most evolved aspect of the game during its development.

[b][i]Before changes[/i][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/d43ad34910f8b09fa41be3c3e9bf52b2a0a8bd10.png[/img]
[b][i]After changes[/i][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/24b154d84feb0e4681cba9267385a3af08e09099.png[/img]
After the first demo, I received much more feedback than I expected, including from prominent streamers whom I admired and followed. [b]This feedback proved invaluable in shaping the game’s direction[/b]. Following a video on Forgotten Mines made by [url=https://youtu.be/b8RxfJxxqAo?si=JwOak5cfA_cY0XnE]Retromation[/url], I released the first update, addressing the initial difficulty that was deemed excessive. And after a video from [url=https://youtu.be/0whVwbms-4k?si=_g_WtCCi5TI8K_Um]Splattercat[/url], the game’s music underwent a significant transformation, evolving from a neutral concept [b]to a more thematic approach[/b], aligning more closely with viewer comments.

But, what I remember being the most critical decisions shaping Forgotten Mines’ would be [b]the turn limit[/b]. This mechanic, along with reinforcements and related elements, sparked recurring debates among the players I closely followed—from streamers to testers. But really, I feel that this somewhat contentious mechanic [b]serves as the backbone of Forgotten Mines' gameplay loop[/b]. Just like the E.M.M.I from [i]Metroid Dread[/i]: the game wouldn't exist without the discomfort these antagonists create.

As you can see, Forgotten Mines wouldn't be where it is now if it wasn't for the [b]players' precious feedback[/b], so if you have any thoughts to share, please do! And a huge thank you to everyone who takes the time to provide constructive criticism!

That's it for today, thank you for reading! I'm looking forward to you playing Forgotten Mines in less than a week!

Because: Forgotten Mines will be available on [b]July 23rd[/b]!
Until then, you can of course [b]wishlist the game[/b]:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2238630/Forgotten_Mines/

If you want to chat with me and other players, you can join the [url=discord.gg/pFreZSEgxQ][b]Discord[/b][/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/forgotten_mines][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!

notes.title: Mastering the Meta
notes.content:
Good day Heroes,

We've explored the intricacies of tactical battles, leveling mechanisms and other wonderful key themes to master in order to successfully win your run. Let's delve deeper into the world of Forgotten Mines with a very important subject: [b]the Meta[/b].

[h2]Currencies[/h2]

There are [b]four of them[/b]: Iron Ore, Gold Ore, Gems and Kingdom Coins. Iron and Gold serve as currencies during the expedition, used to purchase items and supplies within the mines, that is, they exist so the player's expedition is as successful as possible. Gems are used to improve future expeditions and can be exchanged for Kingdom Coins, which are crucial for [b]passive improvements[/b] for future expeditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/2fbd093005fa15d8b3354b104c0013adbd1a6dd2.png[/img]
Iron is essential for upgrading equipment at the [b]Blacksmith[/b], while gold is extremely important to buy various items in the Shop and [b]Reroll[/b] the items you can buy. Gems act as the primary meta-currency, while Kingdom Coins, although seemingly less valuable, are actually the most costly. The idea here was to generate an order of importance between varied resources, similar to the resource management in games like [i]Heroes of Might and Magic III[/i], where each resource [b]has its unique utility and significance[/b].

[h2]Amulets[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/550e902df7262d0890a5f54ec87ba30ca9188306.jpg[/img]
Players must select [b]three amulets[/b] from a wide range of bonuses to carry on their run. While some offer situational effects, others are even quite counterintuitive in their possible uses. The truth is, these [b]amulets can synergize with class choices[/b], forming powerful combinations.

I believe that players will discover and experiment with both expected and unexpected combinations, leading to exciting gameplay discoveries (that I can't wait to read about). 

[h2]Basically, here's what you should know[/h2]

Forgotten Mines' encompasses [b]three key areas crucial for progression[/b]. Firstly, the [b]Magic Shop[/b] offers a variety of Amulets that players can unlock and purchase using Gems, each granting unique bonuses that can significantly impact gameplay. Secondly, in the [b]Barracks[/b], players unlock new classes for future expeditions. Lastly, the [b]Guilds[/b] will let you invest Kingdom Coins into various Guilds, acquiring new [b]passive abilities that enhance your power[/b] with each investment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/1372c4fb85f8dbe06a935a4be81e267e9c435e81.png[/img]
[h2]Introducing new Meta content[/h2]

One concern that weighed heavily on my mind was the risk of power creep when introducing new content. I believe it's okay for there to be a certain unevenness, or even a stratification of content: not every Pokémon needs to be Arceus and not everything needs to be Rattata. The key is to establish different tiers with defined limits, [b]ensuring balance and diversity[/b]. Based on this, creating additional content becomes a little simpler and more objective. Not to mention that “Arceus” are more expensive and more difficult to obtain than “Rattatas”, wink wink.

Anyway, thank you for reading, I'm looking forward to you trying out the game with its [b]brand new demo[/b]!

And don't forget: Forgotten Mines will be available on July 23rd!
Until then, you can of course [b]wishlist the game[/b]:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2238630/Forgotten_Mines/

If you want to chat with me and other players, you can join the [url=discord.gg/pFreZSEgxQ][b]Discord[/b][/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/forgotten_mines][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!

notes.title: Forgotten Mines will release in July!
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes!

I am beyond thrilled to finally share the official launch date of my tactical RPG. Mark your calendars and get ready to delve into the harsh world of Forgotten Mines on [b]July 23rd[/b]!

Set up your team, start your run, kill all the monsters in the room and pray to get the best possible equipment for your Heroes!

Enjoy the brand new [b]trailer[/b] for the occasion:
[previewyoutube=tL8BkHE1GFY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]What you should expect from Forgotten Mines[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Tactical Combat:[/b] engage in intricate tactical battles where [b]every decision matters[/b]. Position your Heroes carefully, find the enemies' weaknesses, and use the environment to your advantage!

[*] [b]Roguelite Elements? No way![/b] Yes way! Randomized levels and permadeath ensure that each run is unique. More replayability!

[*] [b]Diverse Classes:[/b] fighters, wizards, healers, archers and the list goes on. Each with their own unique abilities and skills! [b]Customize your team[/b] to suit your playstyle and find endless strategies.

[*] [b]Find & Buy Equipment:[/b] everything you equip will grant you different bonuses and sometimes, penalties. Pick wisely!

[*] [b]Enemies to Slay:[/b] each room a new challenge. From Goblins to Orcs and other dangerous foes, you better [strike]catch[/strike] slay them all. Unlock the enemies in the game's [b]Compendium[/b] and don't forget to share yours!

[*] [b]Boss Rooms:[/b] at the end of each floor, you will face epic boss battles. Powerful adversaries with unique abilities will try and slay your entire party, good luck with that!
[/list]
Thanks for reading, I'm excited for you all to play the game!
Until July 23rd, you can of course [b]wishlist the game[/b]:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2238630/Forgotten_Mines/

If you want to chat with me and other players, you can join the [url=discord.gg/pFreZSEgxQ][b]Discord[/b][/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/forgotten_mines][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!

notes.title: From Inspiration to Creation
notes.content:
Welcome to this new blogpost Heroes!

Today, let's embark on a journey into the setting of Forgotten Mines, drawing inspiration from classic fantasy, ancient myths, and the nostalgic memories of my childhood games. My little RPG will hold no secrets for you after reading this!

[h2]Works inspiration[/h2]

To develop Forgotten Mines, I got inspired by existing games which served as a powerful blueprint for shaping my own. As a teenager, I used to play RPGs a lot with my friends and I was the one insisting on playing a Dwarf character. I used to open the Player's Handbook and read about the organization of the races, cultural issues, etc. In the Monster Manual, the many different Dwarves made me want to find out more about them.

As for other inspiring works, let’s say that Berserk was a huge influence. I ended up watching the 1997 animated series, without knowing what it was. I was very young and it tore me apart in a way that I can't explain. I simply sensed a desire to evoke in others the same emotions that had stirred within me.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/34bf708588c270b5b97d2adc1617d4455c47d588.jpg[/img]
After Berserk, Forgotten Realms also inspired this game a lot, being the RPG scenario that I played the most. And, lately, I've ended up getting very interested in Dune, but that was after I'd already laid the groundwork for Forgotten Mines, otherwise we'd have had the first Desert Dwarves game on Steam, no kidding.

[h2]Myths inspiration[/h2]

While I was vastly inspired by other works, History and Myths gave me wonderful ideas too. For example, there is a legend from Brazil: Boitatá. It is a giant snake with many eyes, surrounded by flames, which protects the fields from invasions and especially fires. Mixing this character design with the Mariliths from D&D; this is how the Sleeths in Forgotten Mines were born.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/3afd0e2ffd5b6e9959b0e5ee845325c1fa45bfe9.jpg[/img]
[url=https://www.artstation.com/artwork/NL1K5]artwork by Jânio Garcia[/url]

I made the Sleeths half women half giant snakes in reference to Boitatá. In the game, they carry elemental blades and are perhaps the most lethal basic units you can stumble upon.

[h2]Sacrifice and choices[/h2]

I shaped Forgotten Mines based on concepts that fascinated me. Another significant inspiration was the notion of the "Divided Line". The Divided Line is an analogy that establishes and orders two realms of being that a person can think about: the intelligible realm is the realm of thought while the sensible realm is the realm of perception. With that in mind, I created the four floors, to symbolize those different realms. The layers, represented  in the game by Verdant Halls, Muddy Tunnels, Ancient Prisons, and Gates of Hell, guide players into a new dimension, unable to return to their previous ignorance.

I see it that way: Forgotten Mines is about a suicide mission to take their mines back,  pushing the characters into a downward spiral of morality. It makes them go through different states of consciousness until the Idea of ​​Evil is defeated beyond the limit of understanding, on another plane.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/b1263d2ec0ba83e038cf2b0883abf092aa90cef4.png[/img]

Growing up in the Global South, I understand the lasting impact of invasion and colonization on a community. Reclaiming land from invaders resonates with many of us here. That’s why, from my perspective, myself and those around me are like the Dwarves in this analogy.

Want to know another not-so-fun fact about Forgotten Mines?
Alongside battles, the player may end up being faced with the possibility of sacrificing their entire party in exchange for becoming a new Demon King, or even encounter a character willing to sacrifice their entire party to make the same pact. There are ancient and forgotten deities within the mines, who can be found and will propose a pact. And perhaps the oddest possibility that comes to my mind right now is engaging in arm wrestling with a naked, gray-skinned giant abomination.

[h2]How Ultimate Shot was created[/h2]

Ultimate Shot is an attack only the archers can cast; it fires 2 to 3 arrows per attack. It is the final arrow attack. And do you know where it comes from? 

During development, a strange bug appeared with the archers. The bug allowed the unit to fire a number of arrows equal to the player's clicks while the unit attacked (like in an action game). It turned out that the bug was so fun and enjoyable that I decided to leave it, that’s how improved attacks and Ultimate Shot were created.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/8c536c20a00467dd9fd111b114124014577210ce.gif[/img]

Thank you so much for reading this blogpost. What we can acknowledge is that Forgotten Mines is my creation but it's also a tapestry from the inspiration of countless other works. Also, know that you all play a part too because each idea and piece of feedback contributes to the game’s evolution, and for that, I am truly grateful!

And don't forget: Forgotten Mines will be available on [b]Steam later in 2024[/b]! Until then, you can [b]wishlist the game[/b] and play the demo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2238630/Forgotten_Mines/

If you want to chat with the team and other players, you can join us on [url=discord.gg/pFreZSEgxQ][b]Discord[/b][/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/forgotten_mines][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!

notes.title: Welcome to Scream Fest
notes.content:
Good day Heroes!

Scream Fest starts today as Halloween gets closer and closer, drawing ghosts and demons out of the shadows. You're left with only one choice: face your fears and vanquish them all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/3338c5c73049e1eccd749e2ead19bf66bfbe8d8e.png[/img]

For the occasion, I just released a brand new demo of Forgotten Mines, with the following changes:
[list]
[*] Optimization 
[*] New color for Diamond ore
[*] New debuff effects on the character sheet
[*] New controls 
[*] More options
[*] Lot of balancing
[*] New spells and skill for early weapons and armors
[*] New special effect for spells and skills
[/list]
Also I released a [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2238630/view/6562365934278711225]new article[/url][/b] last week about the different classes and weapons available in my game!

As a solo dev, wishlists are super important as they will help a lot to boost the visibility of Forgotten Mines, so don't forget to wishlist the game! 

If you play the new demo, I would love to hear what you think about it in the forums:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2238630/Forgotten_Mines/

To chat with me and other players, join my [url=discord.gg/pFreZSEgxQ][b]Discord[/b][/url] and follow Forgotten Mines on [url=https://twitter.com/forgotten_mines][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!
